args.summary: The v2.3.1 deployment of checkout-api failed health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 18%. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with error rate at 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is not yet known and requires investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
All done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: The latest deploy of `checkout-api` (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Rolled out v2.3.0 to all production regions. Verified the service is now healthy with error rate back down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions, and the restored health. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 (and its staging rc) will need investigation before any redeploy is attempted.
